conditions.finding: Paragraphs are too coarse for the article and the legacy bundle is unsuitable for derivative-only sources because it serializes expressive text.

conditions.unitization: printed page, block and sentence with normalized TextPositionSelector
conditions.finding: Every candidate is page-resolved; expressive context is replaced by hashes and selectors. Bare modal verbs are not promoted to RT21.

conditions.unitization: same as A1, with note-zone lexical detection enabled
conditions.finding: Footnote inclusion does not change candidate counts in this work, so notes may remain excluded from default semantic routing.

before_fix.risk: German muss/sollte and metaphorical power language could be mistaken for obligations or coercion.

after_fix.policy: Bare modal auxiliaries yield RT04/RT21 rivals and therefore RT00 until contextual adjudication.

negative_tests.operation: Search the derived bundle for a distinctive source phrase and inspect unit fields.
negative_tests.expected: No unit has a text field and the phrase is absent.

negative_tests.operation: Present a sentence containing only bare muss as its modal cue.
negative_tests.expected: The selected relation is RT00 with RT04 and RT21 rivals.
